import subprocess,pathlib,json,io,tarfile,resource
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(256*1024**2,256*1024**2))
cid="3f9ed75cc9c66a7cb65cc6de0c2d5c4c72224ed02041b2d834dcee4345635d91"
base=["/usr/bin/prlimit","--as=unlimited","--","/usr/bin/docker"]
p=subprocess.run(base+["inspect",cid],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
v=json.loads(p.stdout)[0]
assert v["Id"]==cid and v["Image"]=="sha256:660ce23a83574fdcd28ba126b07615829c06770c06fbdf6533f03cc4d90acdb1"
assert not v["State"]["Running"] and v["State"]["Pid"]==0 and not v.get("ExecIDs")
cp=subprocess.run(base+["cp",cid+":/root/ascend/log/atb","-"],capture_output=True,timeout=12)
out={"read_only":True,"stopped_owned_cid":cid,"source":"/root/ascend/log/atb","exit":cp.returncode,"stderr":cp.stderr.decode("utf-8","replace"),"tar_bytes":len(cp.stdout),"files":[]}
assert len(cp.stdout)<=4*1024**2,"bounded small ATB log snapshot exceeded; do not export"
if cp.returncode==0:
 with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(cp.stdout),mode="r:*") as tar:
  for m in tar:
   if m.isfile():
    assert m.size<=2*1024**2
    text=tar.extractfile(m).read().decode("utf-8","replace")
    lines=text.splitlines()
    hits=[i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if any(q in line for q in ("Reshape","ERROR","[E","param","Param","dtype","dim"))]
    indices=sorted({j for i in hits for j in range(max(0,i-2),min(len(lines),i+3))})
    excerpt="\n".join(lines[i] for i in indices)
    out["files"].append({"name":m.name,"bytes":m.size,"lines":len(lines),"matched_lines":len(indices),"excerpt":excerpt[:32000]})
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
